steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates highlighted QXO had fallen 58 per cent from all-time highs after announcing large deals such as TopBuild, raising questions about the market’s expectations.
In April 2026, Equity Mates noted the shares were up 22 per cent year to date and had outperformed the market, offering context for how the story had been priced recently.
